title: list_sources request
description: The params object of the `list_sources` tool. Sorted source paths with chunk counts. Principal labels are never a caller field: the host supplies the scope (docs/tool-schemas.md).

path_prefix.description: Only record paths starting with this prefix.

roots.description: Root ids to search. Narrows the server's roots, never widens them; absent or null means every root the server allows.
